items.Sentence: Fine screens will be provided upstream of the MBR tanks to remove particulate material to avoid damaging the membranes. A horizontal-packaged drum screen system with a sluiceway for screening disposal will be used.

The MBR process will consist of biological treatment utilizing anoxic, aerobic, and deoxygenation tanks...The MBR process will remove carbonaceous biochemical oxygen demand, nitrogen through nitrification and denitrification.
Membrane separation to remove microbial solids will consist of three parallel covered membrane tanks, membranes, and MBR auxiliary equipment...submerged membrane ultrafiltration.

pretreatment (chloramine injection, sulfuric acid and antiscalant addition)...Chloramine will be injected after the RO feed tank to prevent biological fouling...Sulfuric acid and antiscalant will be injected after the RO feed tank to control mineral scaling of the RO membranes.
Cartridge filters will be provided upstream of the RO membranes to remove particulate matter.

RO removes large molecular weight dissolved organic and inorganic compounds and pathogens by forcing MBR effluent through a semipermeable membrane...two RO trains, each with a design capacity of 0.75 mgd.

The primary functions of UV/AOP include pathogen inactivation and destruction and removal of trace organic compounds...Chloramine will be dosed upstream of the UV reactors (two on duty and one standby) to generate hydroxyl radicals.

Post-treatment stabilization includes calcite contactors...used to adjust pH, add alkalinity and hardness, and stabilize the water quality...Calcite and sodium hydroxide will be used for adjustment of pH, alkalinity, and hardness.
Sodium hypochlorite and liquid ammonium sulfate will be added post-stabilization to provide a 2 milligrams per liter (mg/L) chloramine residual in the product water tank and the distribution piping.

Odor from three foul air streams (fine screens, biological nutrient removal basins, and MBR tanks) will be captured, combined, and conveyed to a single odor control unit consisting of a single-bed carbon adsorber, which will remove hydrogen sulfide and a variety of organic sulfides.
HAWPF recycled water will be pumped to the product water tank for storage and equalization. The product water tank will be a 125,000-gallon cast-in-place concrete tank.
